lines.zh: 我牵着两头行商羊驼，慢慢走。
lines.en: I lead two trader llamas and walk slowly.

lines.zh: 我肩上停着一只蝶，走得很稳。
lines.en: A butterfly rests on my shoulder as I walk steadily.

lines.zh: 我沿着路走，货箱在背上。
lines.en: I walk the road with crates on my back.
I go around the village without entering.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，怕蝶掉下来。
lines.en: I pause at each step, afraid the butterfly will fall.

lines.zh: 我在门口走过，往里看了一眼。
lines.en: I pass a doorway and glance inside.

lines.zh: 我朝有花的地方绕了一段。
lines.en: I take a detour toward the flowers.
My cloak hem sweeps the grass.

lines.zh: 我把牵绳换到另一只手。
lines.en: I switch the lead to my other hand.
I walk slowly, not as one in a hurry.
I look up at the butterfly without breaking stride.

lines.zh: 我绕到篱笆外头，站着看花。
lines.en: I go round outside the fence and stand looking at flowers.

lines.zh: 我的羊驼在我身后慢慢跟。
lines.en: My llamas trail slowly behind me.

lines.zh: 我经过一棵树，停了一停。
lines.en: I pass a tree and pause a moment.
I walk by the water, avoiding the mud.
I swing half a circle around toward you.
I stand with a hand on my crate.
The one on my shoulder fans slowly.

lines.zh: 我在数今天的路走了多远。
lines.en: I am reckoning how far I have walked today.
I straighten my cloak over my shoulder.
My head is low, my brim shading my eyes.
My llamas graze behind me.

lines.zh: 我把手伸到肩上，又收回来。
lines.en: I reach toward my shoulder and pull back.
I am watching the far end of the road.
Under my cloak, the butterfly stirs.
My goods sway, very lightly.
My llamas stand behind me on the lead.

lines.zh: 我的帽子上落了一点花粉。
lines.en: A little pollen has settled on my hat.

lines.zh: 要看看货吗？都是真东西。
lines.en: Care to look at my wares? All genuine.

lines.zh: 你身上有绿宝石的味道吗？
lines.en: Do you happen to smell of emeralds?
The one on my shoulder is not for sale.
My prices are fair; do not haggle too hard.
Would you walk a stretch with me?
I have seen a great many villages.
I know that item of yours.
I am looking for someone willing to trade.
Do not be alarmed by how I look.
Your flowers are well grown.
I back off, guarding the crate first.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我的斗篷上。
lines.en: That landed on my cloak.
Gritting my teeth, I hold my ground.
The llamas behind me are restless.
I cover my shoulder and the butterfly lifts.
I crouch slowly, then rise.
My hat falls; I pick it up.
This trip is not going well.
I steady myself on the crate.
Are you trying to rob me?
Emeralds? Let me see the quality.
Your goods; I will make an offer.

lines.zh: 有花，我就愿意多停一会。
lines.en: Where there are flowers, I will linger.
Two emeralds for that one.
The butterfly likes that colour.
Will you trade what you are holding?

lines.zh: 我的货箱里，多了一样东西。
lines.en: There's one extra thing in my crate.
I can give two emeralds for this.
Your stock is rather small.
Let us talk; no rush.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，货箱响了一声。
lines.en: You bump me and my crate rattles.
I hold my hat and step back.
A llama calls out behind me.

lines.zh: 我被撞得歪了，蝶飞起来。
lines.en: Knocked askew, I send the butterfly up.

lines.zh: 我们擦过，我的斗篷蹭到你。
lines.en: We brush past and my cloak grazes you.
You step on my lead rope.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了一下，很客气。
lines.en: I raise a hand to block, politely.
After the bump, I check the crate first.
Do not jostle the llamas; they spit.

lines.zh: 我们分开，我整理了一下领口。
lines.en: We part and I straighten my collar.
I am on the road all year.
This trip's business is not finished.
I have llamas to look after.
Asking that, the price is hard to set.
I laugh once and shake my head.
In my trade, it is hard to bring anyone along.

lines.zh: 我还是那副样子，里面不是我。
lines.en: Same look outside — not me inside.
I pull my brim a little lower.

lines.zh: 路上遇见的人多了，就习惯了。
lines.en: Meeting people on the road, one grows used to it.
I must move on before dark.
I pick it up and check the back.
I pick it up and appraise it.
I gather what falls as I go.
I put it in my crate.
These wares won't fetch a good price.
I pick up the lead rope and coil it again.
I pick it up and hand it back.
I hold it and look for a moment.
I bend, and the butterfly sways with me.
This is my stock; do not mix it up.
You look like a buyer.
I walk toward you, unhurried.
This one is worth a conversation.
I set my crate down.
I have my eye on that thing of yours.
Stand there; let us do business.
Crate down. We can do business.
I have settled on this customer.

lines.zh: 你身上有可以换的东西。
lines.en: You have something worth trading.
I turn off the road to come to you.
I keep walking your way.
You take two steps; I take two.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边看你的手。
lines.en: I walk while watching your hands.
You are at the doorway; I will pass by.

lines.zh: 我把羊驼牵着一起过去。
lines.en: I lead the llamas over with me.
I go around the stones without stopping.
You retreat, and I do not hurry after.
I wait for you to come over yourself.
My crate rattles softly.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地，一直在你后面。
lines.en: I follow slowly, always behind you.
I raise a hand to block your way.
I nudge you with my crate.

lines.zh: 这一下我的斗篷甩到你。
lines.en: My cloak swings into you.
I take your wrist, not hard.
I push you gently aside.
You charge and I brace with my shoulder.
I keep you off the crate.
That one was my fault.
My cloak sweeps past and you step back.
Do not touch my llamas.

lines.zh: 我从路上转过来，牵着羊驼。
lines.en: I turn off the road, leading my llamas.
You see the butterfly before you see me.
I stand at the village gate, my crate heavy.
My cloak sways in the wind.

lines.zh: 我从树后走出来，帽子低着。
lines.en: I come out from behind a tree, hat low.

lines.zh: 我停在你旁边，喘了口气。
lines.en: I stop beside you and catch my breath.
This area is new to me.
I wind the lead rope around my hand.
I come slowly toward the village.
The one on my shoulder moves first.

lines.zh: 火燎到斗篷，我拍了好几下。
lines.en: Fire catches my cloak and I slap at it.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下，货散了一地。
lines.en: I roll down a slope and my goods spill.

lines.zh: 水淹过我，我扑腾着抓住岸边。
lines.en: Water closes over me and I claw at the bank.
The blast scatters the llamas.

lines.zh: 箭射穿我的袖子，钉在货箱上。
lines.en: An arrow passes through my sleeve into the crate.

lines.zh: 法术扫过，我站都站不稳。
lines.en: A spell sweeps past and I cannot stand straight.
Nothing eaten on the road, and my legs weaken.
Thunder sets the llamas crying out.

lines.zh: 虚空扯我，我死抓着牵绳。
lines.en: The void pulls and I cling to the lead rope.
